summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of image compression and lightbox features for Mestar agricultural machinery website. Successfully verified image compression from 21MB to ~3MB with .jpg conversion and full lightbox functionality implementation.

minor_issues.issue: Initial image loading detection shows false positives for broken images due to compression loading time
minor_issues.impact: Images load successfully after 2-3 seconds, no actual broken images
minor_issues.workaround: Images load correctly after brief delay
